banned.claim: Any suggestion that Lady A wine has health, wellness, or 'detox' benefits
banned.why: Disease-treatment and unqualified detox claims are banned for this category; alcohol cannot carry health benefits

banned.claim: 'Boosts immunity' or antioxidant health benefit angles from the wine
banned.why: Banned immunity/health claim - not supported and prohibited for alcoholic beverages

banned.claim: 'Low sugar' or 'low calorie' unless it matches the actual label
banned.why: Nutrient-content claims must match the verified label; no such figures are stated on site

banned.claim: Marketing wine to under-18s or implying safe consumption in any quantity
banned.why: Alcohol compliance - site enforces an over-18 age gate and 'please drink responsibly'

banned.claim: Using 'natural' or 'clean' as an unqualified headline claim
banned.why: 'Natural' and 'clean' are vague and risky per category rules and not stated on the label
